lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the branchial region. Primary centroids form vertical columns of 3 to 4 nodes, with horizontal spacing between columns approximately 1.5 times the vertical node distance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity (diffuse white) intersect with primary horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating rectangular anchor nodes across the mid-lateral field.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous linear ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow-line on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge and surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibit a high-density cluster of micro-blobs (high-intensity pixels) significantly smaller in diameter than the primary lateral flank blobs.
